settings.name: challengeRequired
settings.description: Whether an instance-key proof must carry a challenge from /federation/attestation/challenge; the issuance servlet enforces it and the two discovery servlets advertise it, each from its own init-param, so set the three alike

when_wrong.detail: Anything but true, in any case, means false; servlets that disagree advertise one thing and enforce another

settings.name: OIDF_ATTESTATION_CUSTOM_CLAIMS_REQUIRED
settings.description: Claims every instance-key proof must carry besides the protocol's, comma-separated: enforced by the issuance servlet and advertised as custom_claims_required; the init-param customClaimsRequired on each of those two servlets wins over the system property and the environment

when_wrong.detail: Read as given, split at commas only (the format's words reading also splits at spaces and refuses a list of nothing, which this reader does not); a claim a client does not send refuses its every issuance

settings.name: OIDF_ATTESTATION_CUSTOM_CLAIMS_SUPPORTED
settings.description: Claims the client attestation service document advertises as custom_claims_supported, comma-separated; advertised only; the init-param customClaimsSupported on the metadata servlet wins over the system property and the environment

when_wrong.detail: Read as given, split at commas only (the format's words reading also splits at spaces and refuses a list of nothing, which this reader does not); nothing enforces it

settings.name: challengeEndpointEnabled
settings.description: Whether the client attestation service document advertises challenge_endpoint; on the metadata servlet

when_wrong.detail: Set to anything but true, in any case, means false

settings.name: attestationSigningAlgValuesSupported
settings.description: The algorithms the client attestation service document advertises as attestation_signing_alg_values_supported, comma-separated; on the metadata servlet, advertised only

when_wrong.detail: Read as given, split at commas only (the format's words reading also splits at spaces); blank, or a list of nothing such as ", ,", is the default, and nothing checks it against the keys attestations are signed with

settings.name: openBaoUrl
settings.description: OpenBao's address for attestation signing keys (a client's attestation_signing_key_ref), on the issuance servlet; used only with openBaoToken, and with either unset both come from OIDF_OPENBAO_URL and OIDF_OPENBAO_TOKEN and their fallbacks (hosted-entity-signing)

when_wrong.detail: Wrong or unreachable: a client whose attestation_signing_key_ref needs the vault is refused with server_error

settings.name: openBaoToken
settings.description: The OpenBao token for the same, on the issuance servlet; used only with openBaoUrl

when_wrong.detail: Refused by OpenBao: as for openBaoUrl

settings.name: OIDF_ATTESTER_FEDERATION_ENTITY
settings.description: An OpenID Federation entity whose signed statement maps SPIFFE IDs to clients, consulted before the CIMD document and PingFederate's client store, and trusted only through a chain to a pinned trust anchor (OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_ANCHOR_JWKS); an entity the anchor stops vouching for loses its clients within 300 s

when_wrong.detail: Named with no trust anchor pinned: the attester refuses to build its client sources at its first request

settings.name: OIDF_ATTESTER_SIGNING_JWK
settings.description: The attester's private signing key as an inline JWK, applied to every client the federation entity or the CIMD document describes; never read from those documents

when_wrong.detail: Missing or malformed: those clients are refused (invalid_client) at issuance, unless an entry names a signing_key_ref

settings.name: OIDF_ATTESTER_CIMD_URL
settings.description: A Client ID Metadata Document as a client source, honoured only with OIDF_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE=development (plan item M-1, F-0067): the document hands the attester every client's bindings and trust roots, so whoever answers at the URL chooses the keys the attester accepts

when_wrong.detail: Set outside development: at the attester's first request the cimd source is left out with an ERROR naming the variable, and the other sources keep serving

settings.name: OIDF_CIMD_TRUST_BUNDLES
settings.description: Only whether it is set counts: set, with OIDF_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE=development, the client attestation service document lists cimd in client_metadata_sources_supported; nothing reads its value or enforces it

settings.name: OIDF_ATTESTER_OP_ISSUER
settings.description: The hosted attester's own entity id, the relying party in a wallet provider's trust chain; with a trust controller configured (OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_CONTROLLER_HOST) it turns on federation-backed wallet provider trust, in preference to OIDF_WALLET_PROVIDER_JWKS

when_wrong.detail: Wrong: no wallet provider's chain resolves, and every wallet instance attestation is refused

settings.name: OIDF_WALLET_PROVIDER_JWKS
settings.description: Wallet providers trusted statically, a JSON object of provider entity id to its JWK Set, used only when federation-backed wallet trust is not configured; the keys are trusted with no trust chain

when_wrong.detail: Not a JSON object: ignored without a word, and every wallet instance attestation refused; an entry that is not a JWK Set is skipped

settings.name: OIDF_ENTRA_AGENT_DIRECTORY
settings.description: The Entra Agent ID directory, a JSON object of asserted oid to directory entry, which registers the entra-directory asserted-context resolver; its ceiling only narrows an evidenced one

when_wrong.detail: Unparseable: no resolver is registered, without a word

settings.name: OIDF_ATTESTER_SPIRE_ENTRIES_URL
settings.description: A SPIRE entries endpoint whose selectors are added to an instance's workload attributes at issuance; unset, no introspection

when_wrong.detail: Unreachable: the instance gets no selectors
